researcher: claude, offline-style read of the vendor docs pages named in each fact (phase 88)

facts.claim: The hosted Sheets MCP server is at https://sheetsmcp.googleapis.com/mcp/v1.
facts.evidence: Page lists the server URL under its product.

facts.claim: Scopes the server accepts: drive.readonly, drive.file, spreadsheets.readonly, spreadsheets; this template asks only for drive.readonly, spreadsheets.readonly.
facts.evidence: Page lists the scopes per product.

facts.claim: The server host plus Google's sign-in and token hosts.
facts.evidence: Sign-in hosts carried over from the google-drive template, which read them from Google's OAuth guide.

facts.claim: Google offers no dynamic client registration for these servers: you create the OAuth client.
facts.evidence: Carried over from the google-drive template; the page's setup steps create an OAuth client.

choices.because: least privilege; the write scopes are opt-in by editing the scope list

open: Tool names and which tools write are not documented on the page.
